learning_outcomes.text: Analyze and design systems in the field of machines.
Acquire knowledge in machine theory and design.
Express and communicate ideas related to the construction of machines and mechanisms.
Master the usual calculations and tools in the field of machine construction.

syllabus_topics: Stress analysis. Loadings (Tension, Bending, Torsion). Mohr's circle
Identification of Failure Modes. Macroscopic Aspects
Design for static strength. Ductile Materials
Design for static strength. Brittle Materials
Design for fatigue strength. Fatigue Theories. Stages. Fatigue strength. Fatigue Strength Limit
Design for fatigue strength. Modifying Factors. S-N Curves Different types of effort
Design for fatigue strength against fluctuating loads
Cumulative fatigue damage Miner's Rule and Manson's Hypothesis
Lewis equation for static calculation. AGMA influence factors

assessment_methods.method: Calculation and design work of a mechanical assembly to be developed in groups of 2

assessment_rules: To pass the course, students must independently pass the exams for each teaching unit, attend a minimum of 4 out of 5 practical sessions, and achieve a weighted average of all evaluation elements (exams, practical sessions, and project) equal to or greater than 5.0 out of 10.0. In case of not passing the exams for teaching units I or II, there will be a resit exam covering only the failed part. If, after the resit exam, students still do not pass each of the two teaching units, the final grade will be the weighted average of the different evaluation activities, but if said average is above 5.0, it will be graded as the highest failing mark (4.9). Active participation in classroom classes may positively influence the final grade, adding to the qualification achieved from the described evaluation activities.
